Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also includes the [Greymon] name. This card can be chosen for text that specifies cards with [Greymon] in their names. This card can't be chosen for text that specifies cards with the name [Greymon].
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as having [Greymon] in its name" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Greymon].")
If both black and red cards are in this card’s digivolution cards, do I get both  and  from this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: This card/Digimon is also treated as having [Greymon] in its name.
[When Digivolving] If this Digimon has a black digivolution card, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If this Digimon has a red digivolution card, ＜Blitz＞.
